title: Enlarge the tick-tape hold-out library to reach n>=5
hypothesis: Registering more/longer SOURCE_HISTORICAL tick-tape hold-out windows would raise the sweep's hold-out trade count to the config minimum, finally making structure_tape vs v1 evaluable on hold-out.
journey_sketch: Register N additional SOURCE_HISTORICAL train windows + >=1 hold-out window (candidate n>=5) and append baseline-vs-candidate PnL-ledger rows on train AND hold-out.
reject_reason: NOT buildable keyless in Era 5. The sweep consumes Alpaca feed=sip SOURCE_HISTORICAL tick-tape EVENT datasets via DatasetStore.replay; more hold-out data needs Alpaca credentials the operator lacks (the exact blocker Era 5 was scoped to avoid) and is explicitly deferred to the credentialed Era-5 continuation (Non-Goals: no tick-tape backfill recorder; datasets-library = roadmap Card 5.9). Era 5's real Yahoo BARS cannot substitute: OHLCV bars carry no trade/quote events, synthesizing them violates the no-fabricated-data rail, and tagging/pooling Yahoo into a sip dataset violates the feed-segregation rail. Re-open when the operator registers real Alpaca hold-out tick data.

title: Promote era-4 structure_tape over v1 on hold-out
hypothesis: The era-4 structure_tape strategy might beat champion v1 on hold-out net R AND net $ once hold-out n>=5.
journey_sketch: Sweep structure_tape vs v1 on hold-out; if survivor (n>=pnl_min_sample_size=5) append the promotion PnL-ledger row (default/v1 byte-identical; champion moved only by the sweep gate).
reject_reason: Non-survivor by insufficient sample. On the current frozen hold-out (PG feed=sip) the champion takes n=1 strategy-trade (< pnl_min_sample_size=5, read from config); structure_tape has no evaluable hold-out either. No promotion possible, and lowering the minimum or pooling feeds is a critical Anti-goal (hold-out-only promotion). Blocked on the same credential-gated hold-out data as enlarge-tick-tape-holdout-library. Re-propose only with materially new evidence (new hold-out datasets or a changed champion).

title: Stored-Yahoo-series library/browser on /structure
hypothesis: A list of already-stored Yahoo series (symbol/timeframe/window/checksum) on /structure would improve discoverability of the store-first cache.
journey_sketch: Add a stored-series list/health panel to /structure reading GET /research/bars verbatim.
reject_reason: Out of scope for Era 5. This is the deferred full /datasets library-management UI (list/health/delete/regime) — an explicit Era-5 Non-Goal (roadmap Card 5.9). The only new surface this era permits is the /structure fetch control, already shipped and browser-verified as J-05. No in-scope, non-deferred surface gap remains.
